DetailsDocument.ShortDescription: Production-ready pgagroal container for PostgreSQL with non-root security, signed multi-arch images, Kubernetes Helm chart, and zero telemetry.
DetailsDocument.LongDescription: Elevarq pgAgroal is an open-source (BSD-3-Clause) production-ready container image for pgagroal, the high-performance connection pooler for PostgreSQL. Built from pinned upstream pgagroal 2.1.0 sources on Debian, it is designed for secure, repeatable production deployments. The runtime runs as a non-root user (UID 1000), drops all Linux capabilities, uses a read-only root filesystem, and defaults to the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile. Multi-architecture images (linux/amd64 and linux/arm64) are cosign-signed using GitHub OIDC and include an SBOM and SLSA provenance. A production-ready Helm chart simplifies Kubernetes deployment with liveness and readiness probes, a PodDisruptionBudget, least-privilege security contexts, and optional Prometheus metrics. Elevarq pgAgroal contains no telemetry and sends no data outside your environment.
Highlights: Hardened runtime: non-root (UID 1000), read-only root filesystem, all Linux capabilities dropped, seccomp RuntimeDefault
Multi-arch (amd64/arm64), cosign-signed with SBOM and SLSA provenance attestations
Helm chart for Amazon EKS: liveness/readiness probes, PodDisruptionBudget, optional Prometheus metrics
DetailsDocument.SupportDescription: Community support via GitHub Issues at https://github.com/Elevarq/pgAgroal. Report security vulnerabilities to security@elevarq.com (see SECURITY.md).
